authoring_rule: No measure may be authored in the BI tool. If it is not in the 49-metric registry, it is not a measure.

measures.name: Revenue (total, ledger-derived)
measures.description: SUM(signed_amount) WHERE account_type='INCOME', reversal-excluded convention (v_account_balances).
measures.date_basis: journal_entries.entry_date (journal_lines carries this denormalised at export)

measures.name: Revenue by month
measures.description: GROUP BY organization_id, property_id, date_trunc('month', entry_date) of M.REV.001's reconstruction.

measures.name: Collections (application-level)
measures.description: SUM(receipts.amount_paid) WHERE NOT is_deleted

measures.name: Collections by month
measures.description: GROUP BY date_trunc('month', payment_date) of M.COL.001's reconstruction.

measures.name: Collections (ledger-derived)
measures.description: SUM(debit) WHERE journal_entries.source_table='receipts' AND account_code IN ('1110','1120'), reversal-excluded.

measures.name: Invoice billed amount
measures.description: SUM(invoices.total_amount) WHERE NOT is_deleted
measures.date_basis: COALESCE(invoice_date, (billing_month||'-01')::date, created_at::date) per get_universal_metrics; invoice_date alone for a simpler reconstruction

measures.name: Invoice count
measures.description: COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE NOT is_deleted, optionally grouped by invoice_type/status.
measures.date_basis: invoice_date or billing_month depending on the question

measures.name: Deposit held
measures.description: SUM(credit-debit) WHERE account_code='2100' AND party_kind='tenant', reversal-excluded.
measures.date_basis: entry_date (not a filter for the current balance)

measures.name: Deposit settlements
measures.description: deposit_settlements table, live rows (NOT is_deleted), with status IN ('completed','approved') as the ledger-posting gate.

measures.name: Deposit refunds
measures.description: SUM(deposit_settlements.refund_amount) WHERE NOT is_deleted (source) OR SUM(ledger credit on 11xx accounts, source_table='deposit_settlements') (ledger).

measures.name: Expenses (total, ledger-derived)
measures.description: SUM(signed_amount) WHERE account_type='EXPENSE', reversal-excluded.

measures.name: Expenses by category
measures.description: v_pnl_by_category's 9 hand-written account_code LIKE-pattern buckets, PLUS a required 10th 'electricity' bucket (account 5150, '515%' pattern) that the 9 named buckets do NOT capture.

measures.name: Owner payments (source total)
measures.description: SUM(COALESCE(escalated_amount, base_amount)) FROM owner_payments, status IN ('paid','pending') for the period-relevant subset, or all rows for an all-time total.
measures.date_basis: bill_date (ledger-posting basis, per normalize_owner_payment_journal_dates) OR COALESCE(paid_date,due_date) (v_diag_owner_rent_missing_from_profit's basis) -- T

measures.name: P&L by month
measures.description: M.REV.002 and M.EXP.001's monthly reconstruction, joined at (property_id, month) grain, net_profit = revenue - expenses.

measures.name: Cash balance
measures.description: SUM(signed_amount) WHERE account_code IN ('1110','1120'), reversal-excluded, all-time (a running balance, not period-scoped).
measures.date_basis: entry_date (not a filter for the current balance -- this is a running total)

measures.name: Trial balance / accounting checks
measures.description: TWO views exist: v_trial_balance (reversal-excluded, only accounts with activity) and v_trial_balance_detailed (reversal-included via raw journal_lines, ALL 57 COA accounts including zero-activity ones via LEFT JOIN).

measures.name: Staying tenants
measures.description: COUNT(*) WHERE staying_status = 'Staying', at either the allotment grain or DISTINCT tenant_id grain.

measures.name: On-Notice tenants
measures.description: COUNT(*) WHERE staying_status = 'On-Notice'.

measures.name: Booked beds
measures.description: COUNT(*) beds WHERE NOT has_staying AND has_booked (per v_occupancy's construction) or COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) WHERE staying_status='Booked' (per v_active_tenants).

measures.name: Tenant lifecycle (staying_status sync)
measures.description: tenants.staying_status is DERIVED, not independent: priority order Staying(1) > On-Notice(2) > Booked(3) > else(4), tie-broken by most-recently-created allotment, kept in sync by sync_tenant_staying_status (AFTER INSERT/UPDATE) and sync_tenant_staying_status_on_delete (AFTER DELETE) on tenant_allotments.

measures.name: Move-ins
measures.description: tenant_allotments WHERE onboarding_date IS NOT NULL, event_date=onboarding_date, event='move_in'.

measures.name: Move-outs
measures.description: tenant_allotments WHERE actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL, event_date=actual_exit_date, event='move_out'.

measures.name: Exit reconciliation
measures.description: v_exit_reconciliation_worklist: joins tenant_allotments (staying_status='Exited') to v_tenant_current_dues (Def B AR, reversals INCLUDED), plus LATERAL sums of invoices by reference_type/invoice_type, plus the latest deposit_settlements row per allotment.

measures.name: Maintenance volume
measures.description: COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_tickets, GROUP BY status/month/property.

measures.name: Maintenance cost (2 paths)
measures.description: Path A (v_maintenance_metrics): maintenance_tickets LEFT JOIN ticket_resolutions LEFT JOIN expenses ON ticket_resolution_id, dated by ticket created_at month. Path B (v_maintenance_by_issue_type): expenses.issue_type_id direct join to issue_types, requires ticket_resolution_id IS NOT NULL, dated by expense_date.
measures.date_basis: Path A: maintenance_tickets.created_at (ticket creation month). Path B: expenses.expense_date.

measures.name: EB/electricity usage and cost
measures.description: electricity_readings (units_consumed, unit_cost per apartment/billing_month) and eb_payments (bill_amount per property/bill_date).
measures.date_basis: electricity_readings.billing_month (TEXT, 'Mon-YY' format -- see Known limitations); eb_payments.bill_date (a real DATE column)

measures.name: EB tenant allocation
measures.description: per_day_rate = ROUND(total_apartment_bill / total_tenant_days); tenant_eb_charge = per_day_rate * tenant_stay_days. Formula reverse-engineered from data (NOT from an exported function body -- no allocation function is among the 25 exported).
measures.date_basis: billing_month (TEXT, 'Mon-YY' format -- same DQ.028 defect as M.EB.001)

measures.name: Aging
measures.description: v_tenant_aging: buckets by CURRENT_DATE - charge_date, on raw journal_lines account 1200 (reversals INCLUDED, same convention as M.AR.001B).
measures.date_basis: CURRENT_DATE - entry_date (bucket boundary), entry_date (charge date itself)

measures.name: Deposit risk
measures.description: UNION of v_diag_deposit_phantom (32 rows) and v_deposit_ledger_anomalies (22 rows, 3 anomaly types).

measures.name: Phantom deposits
measures.description: tenant_allotments WHERE deposit_paid > 0 AND staying_status IN ('Exited','Cancelled') AND NOT EXISTS(a matching, non-deleted deposit_settlements row).

measures.name: Duplicate invoices
measures.description: GROUP BY allotment_id, billing_month, invoice_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 1, on live invoices.
measures.date_basis: Not applicable to the grouping itself (billing_month is the grouping key)

measures.name: Duplicate receipts
measures.description: receipts_dedup_audit table: groups by (tenant_id, payment_date, amount_paid, reference_number), duplicate_count 2-6, one-time detection pass (detected_at all = 2026-04-22).

measures.name: Overlapping allotments
measures.description: For each bed_id, pairwise interval-overlap check on [onboarding_date, COALESCE(actual_exit_date, snapshot_date)].

measures.name: Ledger/source reconciliation
measures.description: See M.COL.003 (receipts), M.INV.001's ledger cross-check (invoices), M.DEP.002 (deposit settlements).

measures.name: Data-quality score / trust status
measures.description: COUNT of metrics in this registry by ai_trust_status.

measures.name: Current rent per bed
measures.description: tenant_allotments.monthly_rental of the live allotment on each bed (staying_status='Staying' AND actual_exit_date IS NULL), one value per bed. Never summed and never averaged into an apartment figure.
measures.date_basis: onboarding_date (used only to pick the latest allotment on a bed; monthly_rental itself carries no effective date)

conflict_tables.description: SUM(signed_amount) WHERE account_code='1200' AND party_kind='tenant', GROUP BY tenant_id, allotment_id, from v_account_balances.
conflict_tables.date_basis: entry_date (for last_charge_date/last_payment_date only; not a filter on the balance itself)
conflict_tables.reason: Competing evidence-backed definitions exist. Authoring this as a single DAX measure would silently pick one.

conflict_tables.description: Per-account SUM(debit-credit or credit-debit) for accounts 1200/2100/2400, GROUP BY tenant_id, allotment_id, from raw journal_lines (no reversal filter).
conflict_tables.reason: Competing evidence-backed definitions exist. Authoring this as a single DAX measure would silently pick one.

conflict_tables.name: Tenant dues -- Def C: application tenant_allotments.balance_due
conflict_tables.description: tenant_allotments.balance_due, as stored (no reconstruction logic -- it is itself the source).
conflict_tables.date_basis: Not applicable (a current-value column, not an event)

conflict_tables.name: Tenant dues -- Def D: tenant_transactions (frozen legacy ledger)
conflict_tables.description: SUM(amount WHERE direction='DEBIT') - SUM(amount WHERE direction='CREDIT') per allotment, filtered to ledger_type IN ('CHARGE','PAYMENT'). TWO sub-variants exist: unclipped (can net negative across the total) and GREATEST(...,0)-floored per allotment.
conflict_tables.date_basis: date (NOTE: 1 row has a corrupt year, '0206-03-27' -- DQ.023)
conflict_tables.reason: Competing evidence-backed definitions exist. Authoring this as a single DAX measure would silently pick one.

conflict_tables.description: Same four definitions as M.AR.001A-D, filtered to WHERE tenant_id = <x> (or allotment_id = <x>).
conflict_tables.reason: Competing evidence-backed definitions exist. Authoring this as a single DAX measure would silently pick one.

conflict_tables.description: Same as M.AR.001A/B, joined to tenant_allotments on allotment_id to bring in property_id, then GROUP BY property_id.

unavailable_measures.name: Occupancy by apartment
unavailable_measures.description: get_occupancy_intelligence's apt/heat CTEs: per-apartment total_beds, occupied_beds_now, day-weighted occupancy_pct, monthly heatmap.

unavailable_measures.name: Occupancy by bed
unavailable_measures.description: get_bed_occupancy_timeline(bed_id, from, to): occupied/vacant day-range segments per bed. get_occupancy_intelligence: adds occupancy_pct, avg_fill_days, avg_stay_days, turnover, realized/potential revenue, a 0-100 score.
unavailable_measures.date_basis: onboarding_date, actual_exit_date, day-range window [p_from,p_to] clamped to LEAST(p_to, CURRENT_DATE)

date_tables: Not applicable to the grouping itself
invoice_date or billing_month depending on the question
date_table_rule: One date table per date basis, joined per metric as the registry documents. A single conformed calendar would silently re-date metrics onto a field their definition does not use.
